'''Mangoriza''' was a drug used for chemical [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. The drug was employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during interrogation of prisoners, especially by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
